root.label: RFA SaxaVord test launch plans paused

events.label: RFA SaxaVord test launch plans paused

slots.name: launch status
slots.sentence: In August, SaxaVord paused plans for a test launch after RFA said it had "encountered an issue".

events.label: UK government £30m investment in SaxaVord Spaceport

slots.name: government investment
slots.sentence: The UK government has announced investment of £30m in SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland as part of a new national space strategy.

slots.name: launch capacity
slots.sentence: SaxaVord is the UK's first fully-licensed spaceport and has regulatory approval for up to 30 rocket launches a year.

slots.name: launch agreements
slots.sentence: Two German companies have signed launch agreements with the spaceport.

slots.name: HyImpulse investment
slots.sentence: The German firm recently secured investment of more than €50m (£43m).

slots.name: European investment
slots.sentence: The money for the Shetland project is part of a £148m investment across Europe which ministers said would help UK space technology firms secure more work.
